budget_items.topic: Formula Grant from Executive Office of Elder Affairs
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Ms. Doherty reported the formula grant will be about $25,000, or $12.00 per elder, and plans to use it for two kitchen assistants and independent contractors for Eagle House activities.
budget_items.quote: but the grant will be for about $25,000, which is $12.00 per elder.

budget_items.topic: State Capital Plan funds for Eagle House HVAC
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The $25,000 State Capital Plan designation for Eagle House HVAC is bonded and unclear when it will be received; repair funds might come from the town budget and be reimbursed when the bond is released.
budget_items.quote: state capital plan $25,000 designated for eagle house hvac: ms. doherty reported she discussed the funds

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Ms. Doherty requested $7,000 from the Eagle House Supporters, who raised it to $9,500.
budget_items.quote: ms. lincoln also reported that ms. doherty requested $7,000 from the supporters and they raised it up to $9,500.

budget_items.topic: Ham and Bean Fundraiser ticket prices
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Tickets for the October 20, 2018 Ham and Bean Fundraiser will cost $8 for adults and $5 for kids under 8.
budget_items.quote: david dorren is working on printing tickets, which will cost $8 for adults and $5 for kids under 8 years old.
